// An on/off dash sequence applied along a stroked contour's arc length.
// Intervals alternate drawn and skipped lengths, starting with drawn, and
// repeat; an empty array means a solid stroke. Phase shifts the pattern's
// starting point along the contour, in the same units.
type DashPattern
    implements IValue
{
    Intervals: Array<Number>;
    Phase: Number;
}
